checklist.action: search codebase for relevant code paths
scope check — output SCOPE_EXPANDED if broader than spec
write diagnosis to .pipeline-state/<branch>-diagnosis.md so later stages can read it
run full test suite (read-only, no source modifications)
verify root cause addressed (not just symptom)
cross-ref diagnosis vs fix — flag if fix diverged
discover project docs structure (read docs/README.md or index)
add/update docstrings for modified public APIs
update existing docs that reference changed behavior
git remote -v — verify github remote exists

9.name: Code Review
9.subagent_prompt: You are reviewing PR #{pr_number} for a bug fix. Project: {project_path}. PR targets {pr_target_branch}. Step 1: Run git diff {pr_target_branch}...HEAD, read changed files. Check docs/PULL_REQUEST_CHECKLIST.md if exists. Review for correctness, security, testing (bug fix MUST have regression test), code quality, docs, perf. Flag auto-reject triggers. Step 2: Run project test suite, report pass/fail. Step 3: Decide APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES/COMMENT. Step 4 MANDATORY: Post review to GitHub with gh pr review {pr_number} --comment --body '<formatted review>'. If REQUEST_CHANGES use --request-changes instead. Save to pr/feedback/ if dir exists. Step 5: Output verdict.

checklist.action: load project PR checklist if exists (docs/PULL_REQUEST_CHECKLIST.md)
verify regression test exists for the bug fix
review: correctness, security, testing, quality, docs, perf
check auto-reject triggers (print/f-string loggers/console.log/except:pass/no tests/phantom modules/mark_safe/stub code/CHANGELOG)
run full test suite, report pass/fail
post review to GitHub: gh pr review --comment with formatted checklist and findings
save to pr/feedback/ if directory exists

10.name: Review Verdict
10.note: Verdict is determined by the Code Review subagent above. If APPROVE, proceed to Merge. If REQUEST_CHANGES, fix issues, re-commit, re-push, re-run Code Review.

checklist.action: if REQUEST_CHANGES: fix issues, re-commit, re-push, re-run stage 9

11.name: Merge PR
11.subagent_prompt: Merge PR #{pr_number} in {project_path}. Run: gh pr merge {pr_number} --squash --delete-branch. Do NOT run gh pr review --approve (GitHub blocks self-approval). Output PR_MERGED or MERGE_FAILED.

12.name: Retrospective
12.subagent_prompt: Write retrospective for bug fix: {task_description}. Project: {project_path}. PR #{pr_number}. Run git log {pr_target_branch}..HEAD. Rate quality 1-5, what went well, lessons learned, improvements. MANDATORY: Post retro as gh pr comment {pr_number} --body '<formatted retro with quality, lessons, improvements>'. MANDATORY: Append to .pipeline-log.md (create if needed, ensure in .gitignore). Output RETRO_COMPLETE.

checklist.action: post retrospective to GitHub PR: gh pr comment
